feed.title: NPR Programs: Morning Edition
feed.subtitle: Morning Edition takes listeners around the country and the world with multi-faceted stories and commentaries every weekday. Hosts Steve Inskeep, Leila Fadel, Michel Martin and A Martínez bring you the latest breaking news and features to prepare you for the day.

entry.title: Crews search for survivors after deadly Brooklyn building collapse
entry.summary: A three-story apartment building in Brooklyn collapsed, killing at least eight people and injuring two dozen others.

entry.title: Jensen Huang biographer reacts to the Nvidia CEO's resignation
entry.summary: NPR's A Martinez speaks with Stephen Witt, author of a Jensen Huang biography, about his resignation from his role as CEO of Nvidia.

entry.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang steps down amid alleged spy scandal
entry.summary: Huang co-founded the chipmaker Nvidia, which has become one of the driving forces behind the AI boom. But reports that he may have had an affair with an alleged Chinese spy quickly sank his career.

entry.title: Kennedy Center plans Ticketmaster switch, raising conflict of interest concerns
entry.summary: The Kennedy Center's former president Richard Grenell was a paid board member of Ticketmaster's parent company at the same time the two parties were negotiating.

entry.title: Trump proposed a 'secret weapon' to police colleges. It will soon become reality
entry.summary: In a 2023 campaign speech, Trump pledged to reclaim universities from what he called the radical left. His Education Department just finalized a rule to help him do it.

entry.title: Former Ukrainian foreign minister discusses how to bridge gaps between Ukraine, Russia
entry.summary: NPR's A Martinez asks Ukraine's former Foreign Minister Dmytro Kuleba for his proposals to close gaps in talks between Russia, Ukraine and Europe.

entry.title: Former U.S. Ambassador William Taylor discusses the latest Russia-Ukraine talks
entry.summary: NPR's A Martinez speaks with former U.S. ambassador to Ukraine, William Taylor, about the ongoing peace talks between the U.S., Russia and Ukraine.

entry.title: U.S. officials set to meet with Putin, Zelenskyy following Abu Dhabi peace talks
entry.summary: U.S.-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi have wrapped up with an agreement on a Russia-Ukraine prisoner exchange. U.S. negotiators meet with Vladimir Putin on Thursday and Volodymyr Zelenskyy on Friday.

entry.title: Director James Gray and actor Miles Teller discuss crime drama 'Paper Tiger'
entry.summary: NPR's A Martinez talks to director James Gray and actor Miles Teller about the film "Paper Tiger," in which a family gets pulled unwittingly into the business of the Russian mafia.

entry.title: Leaders at the U.N. climate summit urged to get tougher on global warming
entry.summary: World leaders are gathered in Turkey for climate talks, after a year of conflict that has frayed international ties and upended global energy markets. One conspicuous absence: the U.S.
